what.text: This page follows refugees from Togo living in Ghana, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3405 Togolese refugees in Ghana, 26.9% of all refugees from Togo.
Benin hosts the most Togolese refugees, followed by Ghana, France and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Togo: over the government, with JNIM, from 2022 to 2025.
The fact pack does not give reasons for the displacement in the 1990s.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at its highest figure, 135000 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1993 to 1995, and the figure has fallen since.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Ghana.
These are year-end totals for Ghana only, reported to UNHCR.
